# GlobalTechEvents

> Unified calendar of globally known major tech events, with an events directory and evergreen conference guides.

GlobalTechEvents publishes English pages for the home calendar, the events directory, and conference guides. Confirm dates and registration on the organizer site.

The public event catalog is live. GET https://www.globaltechevents.xyz/api/events returns JSON: an events array. Each item has name, dates.start, dates.end (YYYY-MM-DD), city, url, and slug. url is the organizer site when one is listed, otherwise the event guide on this site.

## Hubs

- [Home calendar](https://www.globaltechevents.xyz/): Major tech events in one calendar.
- [Events directory](https://www.globaltechevents.xyz/events): Index of crawlable event guides.
- [Guides](https://www.globaltechevents.xyz/guides): Evergreen compare and best-of guides.
- [For agents](https://www.globaltechevents.xyz/for-agents): Humans can copy a prompt on this page for ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor that fetches the live catalog.
- [AI conferences](https://www.globaltechevents.xyz/topics/ai): Industry AI conferences on this calendar, with guides for GTC, Cloud Next, Build, DevDay, Databricks, re:Invent, and KubeCon.
- [AI agent conferences](https://www.globaltechevents.xyz/topics/ai-agents): Agent, builder, and product conferences on this calendar, including DevDay, Build, Cloud Next, re:Invent, and KubeCon.

## Guides

- [AI Conferences in San Francisco 2026](https://www.globaltechevents.xyz/guides/ai-conferences-san-francisco-2026): If a friend asked which San Francisco AI conference is still worth booking in 2026, I would not send them to Moscone. As of 2026-10-16 the only one still ahead inside the city is Reverie, one day on November 5 at the Contemporary Jewish Museum, and I would book it only if the work is training data or multimodal models. The multi-day builder weeks I would still book are outside the city: PyTorch Conference and AGNTCon in San Jose, then ODSC in Burlingame.
- [Best AI conferences 2026](https://www.globaltechevents.xyz/guides/best-ai-conferences-2026): If a friend asked which AI conference is still worth a flight in 2026, I would not hand them the whole year. As of 2026-10-15 I would look at three: Lisbon, Nov 9 to 12, if you need founders and press; Las Vegas, Nov 30 to Dec 4, if AWS is already your estate; Dubai, Dec 7 to 11, if the buyer is in the Gulf. I would skip the other two the moment that is not your room.

## Event catalog

- [Public event JSON](https://www.globaltechevents.xyz/api/events): Live GET catalog. Response shape is `{ "events": [{ "name", "dates": { "start", "end" }, "city", "url", "slug" }] }`.
